connect.title: Connect a WooCommerce shop
connect.intro: With these keys Lagerko reads products and orders from the shop and sends back stock levels. We check that the keys work before saving them.

help.title: Where do I find the keys?
help.step1: In WordPress admin, open WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.
help.step2: Click “Add key”, enter a description (e.g. Lagerko), choose your user and “Read/Write” permissions.
help.step3: Click “Generate API key” and paste the Consumer key and Consumer secret here. WooCommerce shows the secret only once.
help.safety: Keys are stored encrypted and are never shown again after connecting. You can revoke them in WooCommerce at any time.

channels.privacy: From orders, Lagerko reads only products, quantities and status. Customer data (name, address, phone, email) is never fetched or stored.

replace.title: Change keys
replace.hint: Create new keys in WooCommerce (Settings → Advanced → REST API, “Read/Write” permissions). We save them only if the shop accepts them.
